column1: # The position table of targets/macos.md (rules keyCode, isoKeys, standardKeys): the default macOS virtual key code
# (.keylayout key/@code, decimal) per position name, with the standard output of the key where it has one.
# Sources (read 2026-11-28; facts only, see CLEAN-ROOM.md "macOS sources"):
#   chromium = Chromium ui/events/keycodes/dom/dom_code_data.inc (BSD-3-Clause), its Mac column joined by the
#              W3C code value (the position name) of each row:
#   events.h   = the kVK_* constant of the same value in Carbon HIToolbox Events.h (Apple; public SDK mirror
#              https://github.com/phracker/MacOSX-SDKs, MacOSX10.15.sdk); "-" = no constant of that value
#   kiimo      = the output of that key code in the base key map of a layout generated by Kiimo (MIT),
# Columns: position, keyCode (decimal), constant (events.h), output (standard output, UTF-16 units in hex, "-" = none;
# rule standardKeys), source. Backquote and IntlBackslash: macOS delivers codes 10 and 50 swapped from ISO keyboards,
# see rule isoKeys (targets/macos.md §2), which decides those two codes whenever no pin does.
